verdict.rationale: Mastra documents its own workflow engine with typed steps and retries, plus suspend/resume for human-in-the-loop pauses. That covers part of the story: retried steps, and suspension that implies some persisted state. Nothing in the evidence shows agent model and tool calls running as checkpointed workflow steps, or that runs survive a crash mid-execution. Missing for 10: documented crash-recovery and durable checkpointing of in-flight runs, agent loop calls modeled as durable steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an agent builder, I run LLM agent loops as durable workflows — model and tool calls as checkpointed, retried steps that survive crashes mid-run

citations.quote: Compose typed steps, retries, and branches into production workflows your team can inspect and ship.
Mastra workflows also support human-in-the-loop functionality, allowing developers to suspend a workflow and await user input or approval before resuming.
